# Concat

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Concatenate multiple arrays into a single array. Use depth to flatten nested arrays (depth=1 flattens one level, depth=2 flattens two levels).
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/concat",
  "type": "ConcatOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/concat').par.values` (an input) and `op('/concat').out.data` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.values`, `out.data`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `values` | `ListField` | `[]` |
| `depth` | `NumberField` | `1` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->

|------|------|

<!-- gen:end outputs -->
